questions.prompt: Build a single runnable page (HTML + CSS + JS, or a small app) for a fictional productivity tool marketing landing. Include a hero, a three-feature grid, a three-tier pricing table, and a footer. The layout must remain usable at 360px width. Do not make external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: A hero region with a product name and primary call-to-action is visible in the first viewport.
requirements.how: Open the page at the desktop viewport and assert a heading and a clickable primary CTA exist above the fold.

requirements.check: Exactly three feature items are rendered in a grid or equivalent multi-column layout.
requirements.how: Count feature cards or list items under a features section; expect three.

requirements.check: A pricing section exposes three distinct tiers with names and prices.
requirements.how: Locate the pricing section and assert three tier containers each containing a name and a price string.

requirements.check: A footer landmark or footer element is present with at least one link or copyright line.
requirements.how: Query footer or [role=contentinfo] and assert nonempty text or links.

requirements.check: At 360px width, the hero CTA remains visible without horizontal page scroll.
requirements.how: Resize to the mobile viewport, assert the CTA is in view, and assert document scrollWidth does not exceed clientWidth.

interactions: Scroll through hero, features, pricing, and footer
Resize to the mobile viewport and re-check the hero CTA

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable analytics dashboard page with a sidebar, four top metric cards, one line chart, one bar chart, a recent-activity table, and a dark/light theme toggle. Do not make external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: A persistent sidebar or navigation landmark lists at least two destinations.
requirements.how: Query nav or aside and assert at least two navigable items.

requirements.check: Four metric cards each show a label and a numeric value.
requirements.how: Count metric cards; assert four, each with a label and a number.

requirements.check: A line chart is rendered as SVG, canvas, or an accessible chart container.
requirements.how: Locate the line-chart region and assert an svg, canvas, or role=img chart is present.

requirements.check: A bar chart is rendered as SVG, canvas, or an accessible chart container.
requirements.how: Locate the bar-chart region and assert an svg, canvas, or role=img chart is present.

requirements.check: A recent-activity table has a header row and at least one data row.
requirements.how: Query table thead and tbody rows; expect header cells and >=1 body row.

requirements.check: Activating the theme toggle flips a dark/light marker on the document or root container.
requirements.how: Read a theme class or data attribute, click the toggle, and assert the marker changed.

interactions: Click the theme toggle once and observe the root theme marker
Scroll the activity table into view

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable multi-step registration form with three steps, client-side validation, a progress indicator, and a review/submit step that shows error states. Do not make external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: The form exposes three sequential steps before final submit.
requirements.how: Advance through the wizard and assert three distinct step panels or step labels appear.

requirements.check: A progress indicator shows the current step index or fraction.
requirements.how: Assert progress text or aria-valuenow updates when moving between steps.

requirements.check: Submitting an empty required field on step one surfaces a visible validation message without leaving the step.
requirements.how: Clear required inputs, attempt Next/Submit, and assert an error message is visible and the step does not advance.

requirements.check: The final step summarizes entered values before submit.
requirements.how: Complete valid inputs, reach the review step, and assert summarized field values match what was entered.

interactions: Attempt to advance with empty required fields
Fill valid values and advance through all steps to review

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable interactive calculator page (mortgage payment or unit converter) with live results, input validation, and a reset control. Do not make external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: Changing a numeric input updates the displayed result without a full page reload.
requirements.how: Enter a known input set, read the result, change one input, and assert the result text changed.

requirements.check: Invalid input (empty or non-numeric where a number is required) shows a visible error and does not present a fabricated result as valid.
requirements.how: Clear or poison a required numeric field and assert an error is shown and the result is blank or marked invalid.

requirements.check: A reset control restores default inputs and clears the computed result or errors.
requirements.how: Enter values, click Reset, and assert inputs and result return to the initial empty or default state.

interactions: Enter valid inputs and observe the live result
Enter invalid input and observe the error

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable page with a sortable, filterable data table of 50 rows, pagination, row selection, and an empty state when filters match nothing. Do not make external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: The table data source contains 50 rows before filtering.
requirements.how: With no filter applied and page size large enough, count rendered rows across pages or read a total-count indicator of 50.

requirements.check: Clicking a column header reorders rows by that column.
requirements.how: Capture the first cell value, click a sortable header, and assert the first-row value changed according to sort order.

requirements.check: A filter input narrows visible rows to matching records.
requirements.how: Type a unique token from one row and assert only matching rows remain visible.

requirements.check: Pagination controls move between pages when the page size is smaller than the row count.
requirements.how: Set or keep a page size under 50, click next, and assert the first-row identity changed.

requirements.check: Selecting a row marks it as selected in the UI.
requirements.how: Click a row checkbox or row, then assert aria-selected, checked, or a selected class on that row.

requirements.check: A filter with no matches shows an empty-state message instead of stale rows.
requirements.how: Enter a filter that matches nothing and assert an empty-state element is visible and no data rows remain.

interactions: Filter to a single row token
Filter to an impossible token to open the empty state

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable page that opens a modal dialog containing a form. The modal must trap focus, close on Escape, and close on backdrop click. Do not make external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: A control opens a dialog that contains at least one form field.
requirements.how: Click the open control and assert a dialog or [role=dialog] is visible with an input.

requirements.check: Tabbing from the last focusable element inside the dialog cycles focus back inside the dialog.
requirements.how: With the dialog open, Tab from the last focusable control and assert focus remains within the dialog.

requirements.check: Pressing Escape closes the dialog.
requirements.how: Press Escape and assert the dialog is no longer visible.

requirements.check: Clicking the backdrop outside the dialog content closes the dialog.
requirements.how: Re-open the dialog, click the backdrop, and assert the dialog is hidden.

interactions: Tab through focusable elements inside the modal
Re-open and click the backdrop to close

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable image gallery page with a grid layout, a lightbox on click, and keyboard navigation for the lightbox. Bundle or inline placeholder images so the page needs no external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: At least four gallery items render in a multi-column grid at the desktop viewport.
requirements.how: Count gallery items and assert their computed layout places items in more than one column at desktop width.

requirements.check: Clicking a gallery item opens a lightbox or enlarged view of that item.
requirements.how: Click the first item and assert a lightbox dialog or overlay shows the corresponding image.

requirements.check: Arrow keys move between items while the lightbox is open.
requirements.how: With the lightbox open, press ArrowRight and assert the displayed image identity changed.

interactions: Press ArrowRight and ArrowLeft in the lightbox

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable list view that can demonstrate loading, empty, and error states, including a retry control on the error state. Drive the states from in-page controls or stubs so no external network is required at runtime.

requirements.check: A loading state is visible and announces busy or loading status.
requirements.how: Trigger loading and assert a progressbar, aria-busy, or loading text is present.

requirements.check: An empty state shows a message when the list has zero items.
requirements.how: Trigger the empty path and assert empty-state copy is visible with no list items.

requirements.check: An error state shows an error message.
requirements.how: Trigger the error path and assert an alert or error message is visible.

requirements.check: A retry control from the error state re-enters loading or a successful list path.
requirements.how: From the error state, click Retry and assert loading or list content appears.

interactions: Trigger loading, empty, and error states via the page controls
Click Retry from the error state

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable page that must pass an axe-core scan with no violations. Use semantic landmarks, labeled controls, and full keyboard operability for interactive elements. Do not make external network requests at runtime.

requirements.check: The page exposes main and navigation landmarks.
requirements.how: Query main/[role=main] and nav/[role=navigation] and assert both exist.

requirements.check: Every input has an associated accessible name.
requirements.how: For each input, select, and textarea, assert a non-empty accessible name via label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby.

requirements.check: Every button and link is reachable and activatable with the keyboard.
requirements.how: Tab to each interactive control and activate with Enter or Space; assert the expected UI change.

requirements.check: An axe-core scan reports zero violations.
requirements.how: Run axe against the loaded page and assert violations.length === 0.

interactions: Tab through interactive controls and activate each with the keyboard

questions.prompt: Build a single runnable landing page whose HTML+CSS+JS total under 100KB, with no external requests at runtime, targeting Lighthouse performance >= 90 when measured locally.

requirements.check: The sum of served HTML, CSS, and JS bytes is under 100KB.
requirements.how: Sum Content-Length or on-disk bytes for the page and its local assets; assert total < 102400.

requirements.check: During load and scripted interaction, no request leaves the local origin.
requirements.how: Record network requests and assert every request URL is same-origin or data/blob.

requirements.check: A local Lighthouse performance score is at least 90.
requirements.how: Run Lighthouse against the local page and assert categories.performance.score >= 0.9.

interactions: Load the page with network recording enabled
Run the size and Lighthouse checks
